kjv.text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

bsb.text: I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,

web.text: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

leads.kjv: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.

reasons: names “Paul”, who is not in the block

flow.say: Henry shows that Paul prays for spiritual strength in the inner person, not physical power, but the deep resources of God's grace at work in the soul.
This strength comes from God's Spirit and enables believers to serve, resist temptation, and endure with vigor.
Henry also notes that this same Spirit continues the work of grace throughout the Christian life, never stopping.
The goal is for Christ to dwell in the heart through faith, which opens the soul to receive him and unite with him.

morning.say: Ask the Spirit today to strengthen your inner self so you can serve God and persevere with joy.
morning.phrase: strength from the Spirit of God in the inner man
